_avail.description: IP Link® Pro Control Processor, DIN Rail

ports.label: AV LAN
ports.notes: Isolated AV-LAN switch port (separate broadcast domain from primary LAN; for connecting AV devices like touchpanels, switchers, etc).

ports.label: RS-232/422/485 Port 1
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 / RS-422 / RS-485 on a 5-pole 3.5mm captive screw (selectable via software).

ports.label: RS-232 Port 2
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on a 3-pole 3.5mm captive screw (Tx/Rx/GND).

ports.label: RS-232 Port 3
ports.notes: Bidirectional RS-232 on a 3-pole 3.5mm captive screw (Tx/Rx/GND).

ports.label: IR/Serial 1
ports.notes: Programmable IR (carrier or non-carrier, up to 300 kHz) or unidirectional RS-232 ±5V output. 3.5mm captive screw (single-channel: 2-pole; multi-channel: shared on a 4 or 5-pole captive).

ports.label: IR/Serial 2
ports.notes: Programmable IR (carrier or non-carrier, up to 300 kHz) or unidirectional RS-232 ±5V output. 3.5mm captive screw (single-channel: 2-pole; multi-channel: shared on a 4 or 5-pole captive).

ports.label: Relay 1
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1 A max). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: Relay 2
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1 A max). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: Relay 3
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1 A max). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: Relay 4
ports.notes: Normally-open dry-contact relay output (24 VDC, 1 A max). Per-channel modeled.

ports.label: Digital I/O 1
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output (0-24 VDC input, 250 mA sink output). Per-channel modeled — channels share a captive screw block.

ports.label: Digital I/O 2
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output (0-24 VDC input, 250 mA sink output). Per-channel modeled — channels share a captive screw block.

ports.label: Digital I/O 3
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output (0-24 VDC input, 250 mA sink output). Per-channel modeled — channels share a captive screw block.

ports.label: Digital I/O 4
ports.notes: Configurable digital input/output (0-24 VDC input, 250 mA sink output). Per-channel modeled — channels share a captive screw block.

ports.label: eBUS
ports.notes: Extron eBUS differential serial bus on a 4 or 5-pole captive screw (carries +12V/+/-/G). Bus-powers downstream EBP button panels. Modeled as `serial` — no `ebus`/`acp` SignalType in src/types.ts.
